import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 505;
    static long n, m, mod;
    static long[][] C = new long[N][N];
    static long[] dp1 = new long[N];
    static long[] dp2 = new long[N];
    static long[][] dp3 = new long[N][N];
    static long[][] dp4 = new long[N][N];

    static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
        if (C[n][k] != -1) return C[n][k];
        if (k == 0 || k == n) return C[n][k] = 1;
        return C[n][k] = (comb(n-1, k) + comb(n-1, k-1)) % mod;
    }

    static long get_dp1(int i) {
        if (dp1[i] != -1) return dp1[i];
        if (i == 0) return dp1[0] = 1;
        long res = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            res = (res + get_dp1(j-1) * get_dp1(i-j) % mod * comb(i-1, j-1)) % mod;
        }
        res = (i+1) * res % mod;
        return dp1[i] = res;
    }

    static long get_dp2(int i) {
        if (dp2[i] != -1) return dp2[i];
        if (i == 0) return dp2[0] = 0;
        long res = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
            long term1 = (i+1) * comb(i-1, j-1) % mod;
            long term2 = (get_dp1(j-1) * get_dp2(i-j) + get_dp2(j-1) * get_dp1(i-j)) % mod;
            res = (res + term1 * term2) % mod;
            long term3 = comb(i-1, j-1) * get_dp1(j-1) % mod * get_dp1(i-j) % mod;
            long sum = (j*(j-1L)/2 + (i-j)*(i-j+1L)/2) % mod;
            res = (res + term3 * sum) % mod;
        }
        return dp2[i] = res;
    }

    static void compute_dp3_dp4() {
        dp3[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
                dp3[i][j] = dp3[i-1][j];
                dp4[i][j] = dp4[i-1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; ++k) {
                    dp3[i][j] = (dp3[i][j] + dp3[i-k-1][j-k] * get_dp1(k) % mod * comb(j, k)) % mod;
                    dp4[i][j] = (dp4[i][j] + dp3[i-k-1][j-k] * get_dp2(k) % mod * comb(j, k)) % mod;
                    dp4[i][j] = (dp4[i][j] + dp4[i-k-1][j-k] * get_dp1(k) % mod * comb(j, k)) % mod;
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i] = get_dp1(i);
            dp4[i][i] = get_dp2(i);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        mod = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        // Initialize arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(C[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(dp3[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(dp4[i], 0);
        }
        Arrays.fill(dp1, -1);
        Arrays.fill(dp2, -1);

        compute_dp3_dp4();
        System.out.println(dp4[(int)n][(int)m]);
    }
}
